datasets.name: ds_scorecard
queryLines:
SELECT supplier_name, country, region, tier, spend, on_time_rate, on_time_rate_prior_12m,
       on_time_rate_last_12m, lateness_trend_days_per_month, is_declining
FROM mart_supplier_scorecard

datasets.name: ds_risk_top
queryLines:
SELECT part_number, part_name, component_category, top_supplier_name, top_supplier_country,
       top_supplier_region, top_supplier_tier, total_spend
FROM mart_sourcing_risk WHERE is_high_risk ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 200

datasets.name: ds_builds
queryLines:
SELECT week_start, production_line, actual_units, forecast_p50
FROM mart_vehicle_build_plan WHERE week_start >= '2024-01-01'

datasets.name: ds_signals
queryLines:
SELECT site_id, part_number, part_name, component_category, buffer_class, supplier_name,
       supplier_region, supplier_tier, daily_run_rate, days_of_cover, planning_lead_time_days,
       safety_stock_days, suggested_order_qty, suggested_order_value, signal,
       CASE signal WHEN 'EXPEDITE' THEN 1 WHEN 'ORDER' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXCESS' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS signal_rank
FROM mart_buy_signals

datasets.name: ds_sawtooth
queryLines: SELECT part_label, sim_date, policy_name, on_hand_units FROM mart_policy_daily

datasets.name: ds_projection
queryLines:
SELECT part_label, projection_date, on_hand_units, reorder_point_units, safety_stock_units
FROM mart_inventory_projection_daily

lines:
# Supplier performance
How reliable the supplier base is, where it's slow, and who is getting worse. Asia takes about 4x longer than north america. Electronics lead times and lateness spiked during the 2021-22 chip shortage.

frame.title: Lead time by component category (order month)
Spend by region and supplier tier at the time of delivery

lines:
# Sourcing risk
Most auto parts are single-sourced on purpose - tooling is expensive. The risk is depending on a single supplier who isn't reliable: high risk = single-sourced from a tier C supplier.

# Forecast & buy signals
Vehicle builds are forecast 13 weeks out (LightGBM), exploded through the BOM into part demand, then compared with stock to decide what to order. Plant 2 is still ramping.

frame.title: Forecast error by weeks ahead (backtest)
frame.description: Lower is better. LightGBM vs a flat recent-average baseline.

lines:
# Ordering policies
The last 52 weeks of real demand replayed under six ordering policies - same demand, same late deliveries, same starting point. **Stockout rate** is the share of parts that ran out at least once; unit fill rate always looks high because cheap high-volume parts dominate it. Plant 2 is ramping, and only schedule-driven MRP keeps up.

frame.title: Share of parts that ran out at least once
Stockout rate by site and policy
Total cost by buffer class and policy
Sawtooth: on-hand stock for the selected part under each policy
Next 13 weeks from today's stock (current policy)
